title: Second delayed identification, different driver, after O3.3-shaped state
description: Builds on O3.3-shaped state: the scenario sets up the asset's standing assignee as driver B beforehand. The trip runs and closes live (IGN_OFF at 170), then two delayed identifications for the SAME trip arrive after it has already closed: A at deliverAtSec 230 (wins the claim), then B at deliverAtSec 280 (arrives after A already won). Must prove: A's identification wins the claim and both assignees become A. Must NOT change: B's second identification, though persisted, must never contest a claim the trip has already decided; the assignee must stay on A, not revert to B.

driver_identifications.note: first delayed identification for this trip; arrives after the trip already closed and wins the claim
second delayed identification for the same trip, arrives after A already won the claim
